name: What preparations should I make to my waterfront property before listing it for sale?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make to my waterfront property before listing it for sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before listing, focus on enhancing your waterfront property's unique appeal. Ensure all marine structures, like docks and seawalls, are in good repair and compliant with local regulations. Clean up the waterfront area, including removing debris and trimming overgrown vegetation for clear views. Internally, maximize natural light and water views. Consider having a pre-inspection of marine structures, as issues often arise during buyer due diligence. Preparing these elements upfront can streamline the selling process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your waterfront home by ensuring marine structures are sound, cleaning the waterfront, and maximizing views. Consider a pre-inspection of docks and seawalls.
